Approach · OAT-06 Measuring How the Pilot Is Working (Usage Analytics) · S15 General feedback from Settings in both contexts: stored with rating and comment, independent of the other surveys

  • U11 A general (direct) feedback survey exists in the app, separate from and independent of the measured behaviours (UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 3; TFA-94514 AC 5; TFA-94609 Spec 3)

Test design technique: Equivalence classes (equivalence) — Check the same rule again with another class of input (Hospital / Nursing Home, other data); every class has to be right.

Given Fresh physician; T0 recorded

When Open Settings from the Hospital list, rate 2, type a comment, Send feedback; open Settings from the Nursing Home list, rate 5, Send feedback with no comment

Then Two feedback rows: rating 2 with the comment, rating 5 with no comment key; no baseline or handoff_followup row is written; a confirmation shows after each send

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-06 Also confirm 3 + TFA-94514 AC 5: rows read since T0 = exactly two feedback rows with the values above. Copy is S27 (T6); a comment holding a patient name is Q19
